title: investigate and decompose gap route-edit-59b07044: Stop the gap store from silently destroying itself in repos/developme
description:
investigate and decompose gap route-edit-59b07044: Stop the gap store from silently destroying itself in repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts.

Measured incident, 2026-09-09: the gap store went from 4,113 rows to 44 in a single day. Cause: loadGaps() returns an EMPTY array on ANY read or parse failure, and the store is a read-modify-write - load, mutate, save. So one corrupt or transiently unreadable gaps.json yields [], and
